title: Meet Mort, a new character in my game I will use for marketing
author: TheGrowthYardGaming
selftext:
I have been brainstorming on ways to market my game that isn't just gameplay clips and thought I would share. I have been in marketing for 15 years and this is one of the best things I have seen people do for games that really help them go viral or build up an audience on social media. This is the first game I have ever built and I have not started any serious marketing but I have seen this concept get millions of views for multiple other games or even books and films.



Don't judge this clip too hard I hard opus write the script and build this video. I have wrote my own ideas for future content as I build these characters in game. It might not work and this might be an unfunny character to some. I am just trying to share the concept of what I am doing and maybe you will see a way to do this for your game.



My plan is after making enough content and getting the audience familiar with Mort and other interesting people he runs into you will actually see and interact with them in game. My game is still in early beta testing so it's not ready to go full scale on marketing yet.



Just thought I would share what I am doing and would love to hear what other ways people are sharing their games and creating content.
